  "screen_rationale": "The study compares neurophysiological markers of cognitive flexibility between humans and rats performing a probabilistic reversal learning task. It quantifies agreement in behavioral, computational, and electrophysiological measures, fitting the criteria for inclusion.",

  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The study explicitly compares findings from two different species (humans and rats) performing analogous tasks, fitting the 'across-multiple-models' category.",
  "species": [
    "rat",

  ],
  "species_evidence": "The study explicitly analyzes data from rats and humans, and the comparison is aggregated across these two species.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study reports both behavioral indices of cognitive flexibility (e.g., number of reversals, win-stay/lose-shift probabilities) and neurophysiological markers (e.g., RewP amplitude, PE values), which include both hard outcomes and biomarkers."
